title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works
title.orig: An Act to Amend a Certain Item in Republic Act Numbered One Thousand Four Hundred Eleven, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1747_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Republic Act Numbered One thousand four hundred eleven is hereby amended on the following particular:
On page one hundred seventy-A, appendix A, item B-362.16, the words under Column "name and location of project" be changed to read as follows:
"Widening of the National Highway at Lacoblacob Point, Santa Catalina."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
